scraped.title: Strengthening Ukraine's EU-Alignment in the Rule of Law
scraped.subtitle: Strengthening Ukraine’s EU-Alignment in the Rule of Law (3E4U)
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: The project implemented by the GIZ and commissioned by the German Federal Foreign Office (GFFO) supports the Ukraine in aligning its legislation with EU standards, focusing on key negotiation chapters on Judiciary and Fundamental Rights (Chapter 23) and Justice, Freedom and…
body: The project implemented by the GIZ and commissioned by the German Federal Foreign Office (GFFO) supports the Ukraine in aligning its legislation with EU standards, focusing on key negotiation chapters on Judiciary and Fundamental Rights (Chapter 23) and Justice, Freedom and Security (Chapter 24). As part of the project, an Expert Platform is established to provide practical support through capacity building, strategic advice, and legal guidance. It offers targeted training for officials, facilitates knowledge exchange on EU legal standards, and delivers expert input on legislative reforms – helping Ukraine close legal gaps and advance its EU integration process.

ICON-INSTITUT was contracted by the GIZ to provide capacity development, strategic guidance, and legal advice to support Ukraine’s alignment with EU standards, particularly in relation to the rule of law. The focus areas include anti-corruption, fundamental rights, criminal law and the fight against organised crime, as well as EU law more broadly. Services are tailored to the specific needs and requests of Ukrainian partners. Legal short-term experts (STEs) deliver workshops, on-the-job trainings, expert lectures, and legal analyses. They also support the review and drafting of legislation, strategic documents, and reform plans, as well as provide hands-on legal drafting assistance and ad-hoc consultations to support Ukraine’s legislative and institutional reforms.
